tips.text: Radshare the Chassis relic: four players each bring a Radiant copy of the same relic, and never crack it solo.
Find radshares in Recruitment chat or the Vaulted Relic Community Discord.
Run relics for Common parts Intact; Radiant lowers a Common from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Cut the number of Radiants if only you need the Chassis; each player keeps only one reward so extra Rares are wasted.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Bank a steady few Aya a day and buy her relics when her stock is up; Aya and relics never expire.
Buy extra Chassis relics; every one carries it as the Rare.
Do not farm missions for her relics; Varzia is the only source.
Buy her relics from the Market's Prime Resurgence tab to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Start all three part builds at once and keep a free Warframe slot for the final claim.
Almost everyone resents the Aya farm; the pain is stacked luck, Aya first and then the relic.
Results swing widely: radshares can finish a set on about 20 Aya, while solo Radiants burn 50 on one part.
